svg.title: Red Breach - Freight Access paper route, walkable blockout 04

g.text: BLOCKOUT 04 | Walkthrough plan | Built floor heights and room transitions
Lower work floors > raised Security > overhead Maintenance > raised Power Control
A4 +2 m > ladder > Maintenance +6 m > stairs to B4 0 m
HEIGHT AS PART OF THE ROUTE
Enter A2 on its mezzanine; descend to the work floor.
The pump floor B2 and service room C1 sit low too.
Arrival, hub, Records and Generator Hall.
Both faces of doors 1, 2 and 4 meet at this level.
Climb after door 2 into A4; A5 stays raised.
B6 has stairs inside its entry to the control floor.
BcD deploys the 4 m ladder from raised A4.
Three stair flights descend into B4; returnable.
Schematic sections / horizontal spacing is not to scale
Use the tested 0.25 m rise / 0.5 m tread as the starting point.
Each 2 m flight gets 4 m run plus 2 m level landings.
Keep 4 m clear width; 6 m halls have room at the sides.
Doors and turns sit on flat landings, away from the steps.
Outlined decks in A2, A6, B2 and B4 are built mezzanines.
Walk the scale and sightlines; enemy placement follows.
PLAN CHECK / ALL STAIRS CONNECT BACK TO THE HUB DATUM
Stair arrows point uphill. Gold floor labels show height relative to the hub.
Normal route: eight 2 m flights. Maintenance adds a 4 m ladder and a 6 m stair descent.
The closed door-1 approach also has stairs; both approaches to door 4 arrive at 0 m.
Horizontal route distances remain 1,956 m ordinary / 1,314 m via BcD. Vertical travel is additional.
~10-minute target needs the later populated playtest. All stair routes can be retraced; no new forced drops.
Blockout 04 / approved X-Z layout retained. Internal stairs and mezzanines now built for the empty walkthrough.
